coverage.note: No promise records have been imported or verified in this initial dataset. A zero record count describes this register only; it does not mean no public commitments exist.

statusDefinitions.fulfilled: The documented success criteria or target have been achieved and supported by verified evidence.
statusDefinitions.partially_fulfilled: At least one measurable component is achieved, but the full target or all material components are not achieved.
statusDefinitions.in_progress: Documented implementation has begun; this is not inferred from an announcement alone.
statusDefinitions.not_started: The record has been reviewed and no documented implementation has been identified within the stated evidence scope.
statusDefinitions.delayed: A documented deadline has passed and the target remains incomplete.
statusDefinitions.cancelled_withdrawn: An official source documents withdrawal, cancellation or replacement of the commitment.
statusDefinitions.insufficient_evidence: Available records do not establish the current status or measurable progress.
statusDefinitions.under_review: Evidence is being evaluated; no final status conclusion is published.

progressRules: Numeric progress is calculated as verified completed value divided by original target value, capped at 100 percent.
Milestone progress is calculated as completed, evidence-verified milestones divided by the total pre-defined milestones.
Each completed value or milestone must cite one or more evidence records with verificationStatus set to verified.
No progress percentage is shown when the calculation method, denominator or supporting evidence is missing.
Cancelled, withdrawn, not-started and insufficient-evidence records are not assigned artificial completion percentages.
A government announcement or project listing is not evidence that an outcome has been delivered.
methodology.sectorRate: Sector figures are descriptive averages of commitments with a valid evidence-backed progress calculation. They are not a government score or a ranking of political parties.
methodology.comparisonWarning: Comparisons across administrations require compatible definitions, comparable targets and disclosed differences in source coverage, scope and reporting periods.

evidenceAssessmentStates.implementation_evidence_found: At least one reviewed source documents implementation evidence.
evidenceAssessmentStates.reviewed_no_evidence_found: A documented search of specified sources found no implementation evidence; this is not proof that implementation never occurred.
evidenceAssessmentStates.not_publicly_disclosed: The reviewed source set does not publicly disclose implementation information.
evidenceAssessmentStates.not_assessed: No sufficient source review has been completed.
